original_card.question: Does one explicit extension of the connector alphabet offer a favorable completed budget?
methods: Construct and charge a legal extra operation on a minimal instance.
Prove a target-specific bound after adding one specified operation family.
original_card.acceptance_gate: State which fixed-alphabet premise changes and charge its implementation; do not declare it free. A scoped local result may be retained without a complete supplier. Expanding it into further construction rounds requires the family-level budget and obligation gate in research-family-status.md; an optimistic passing relaxation alone is not acceptance.

first_step.inspect: Reproduce the 945-pairing control, then read Exact interface to list the allowed calls.
first_step.scope: Positive control / source-bound orientation only; this is not a new construction or full cold replay.

original_card.first_experiment: Add exactly one legally priced operation and test a tiny dirty-input instance before enumerating larger cases.
original_card.bottleneck_link: A new legal connector operation could change recursive interface cost; a larger census in the same alphabet is a separate side result.
allowed_variations: Choose one additional operation and a small source count for its first counterexample.
scope_change_triggers: Keeping the alphabet and only increasing the source count; record this as a changed assignment.
Extending a source-count census without naming a supplier/interface decision it could change; audit #2973 pruning concerns before relying on the affected predecessor exclusions.

actual_scope: For a restored closed length-30 singleton word, prove that a rank-4 multiplicity-2 sojourn cannot have exactly 16 layer-0 projections. Inside the 8-to-14 layer-1 window this forces at least 17 layer-0 projections and at most 13 layer-1 projections.
scope_change_reason: The card asks for a new connector operation. Open question 1 of pull request 7015 asks whether the published singleton alphabet has a universal length-30 word under the rank-at-least-4 sojourn floors. This package stays in that alphabet and settles only the 16-point rank-4 layer.
bottleneck_link: A universal length-30 word would lower the inherited source-call term f(8) from 32 to 30. Emptying the 16-point rank-4 layer removes one boundary of that search. It does not by itself change a recursive supplier moment or the selected exponent.
stop_rule: Stop once the normalized 16-point fiber census is exhaustive and the rank-4 floor is raised to 17 layer-0 projections. Do not census the 17-point layer, ranks 5 or 6, or length 28.
evidence: PROOF.md reduces a universal rank-4 sojourn with 16 layer-0 points to a normalized two-point fiber packing. layer16_census.c exhausts the 120^7 domain after fixing the identity fiber and finds no cover; verify.py recomputes one branch independently and checks the witness.
author: unpaidmoon
ai_assistance: Substantial Cursor Grok assistance. Independent human and formal proof-kernel review are unclaimed.

open_questions.question: Does a universal length-30 word exist when every rank-4 multiplicity-2 sojourn has at least 17 layer-0 projections and layer-1 size 6 or 8 through 13, while ranks 5 and 6 keep at least 15 and 12 layer-0 projections?
open_questions.why_it_matters: A yes answer lowers the published upper bound on f(8) from 32 to 30. The 16-point rank-4 layer is already empty, and the coverage-255 witness still meets the tightened floor.
open_questions.first_step: Census one rank-4 layer of size 17, whose fiber shape on the 8-to-13 side is one triple and seven pairs, or search one complementary arc with at least 17 layer-0 projections. Treat layer-1 size 6, which forces exactly 24 layer-0 projections, as a separate case.
open_questions.blocked_by: Each quotient direction then has 18 sums available against 16 targets, so the exact packing used for size 16 does not apply. Length 28 is a different question.
